title: Audemars Piguet's five new watches: three Supersonnerie minute repeaters and two stone-dial Code 11.59s
hook: AP just dropped 5 watches. One costs $479,100.
why: Owner asked for this (2026-11-24). AP launched five watches in early November 2026: Royal Oak Supersonnerie in titanium (green dial) and in pink gold (brown Grande Tapisserie), Code 11.59 Supersonnerie in white gold (smoked sapphire), all Calibre 2953, about $397,800 to $479,100; and two 38mm Code 11.59 stone dials (pink gold with onyx, yellow gold with gold obsidian), Calibre 5909. One slide per watch with the official AP photo (Audemars Piguet press images are now permitted: credit 'Photo: Audemars Piguet' on the slide and in the caption). End with a vote: which one would you take? Confirm every price and reference on audemarspiguet.com or a trusted outlet.
